integrity: A general proof and a standalone exhaustive finite checker are provided. The checker corroborates small cases and is not an infinite proof. Classical species and singularity analysis are credited. Source text is not reused beyond bibliographic reference.
scientific_limitations: One total unary function with equality, one free variable, bounded iterate depth, fixed-depth random limit; no conclusion for higher-arity types, varying depth or unrelated signatures. Originality versus all historical literature and independent validation remain unestablished.
title: Sharp quadratic saturation kernels and exact random-mapping laws for bounded unary orbit types
